title: chance

messages.description: outputs a bang at one of the outlets, chosen by the probabilities
updates the probabilities when created with more than one
chance in % of a bang going left, with one or no argument
random bangs according to the probabilities

methods.description: a float sets seed, no float sets a unique internal

body: When [chance] receives a bang, it outputs it at one of its outlets according to their chances (probability weights). There is one outlet per argument, and the total is the sum of all arguments. With one or no argument it has two outlets, and the right inlet sets the chance in % of the left one.
